policy_origin: Root agent prespecified the following deterministic policy before this assignment was computed; no search over seeds, rerolls, response scores or ROI-balance objectives is allowed.
membership: Use every original iResp row in its stored order, via the hash-bound inventory. Retain all 214 original rows in a ledger. Ascending lexicographic tuple of sorted assessment dates as final tie-break
